messages.subject: Hartnell - draft advice note for sign-off
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

Draft advice note attached. Headline: prospects of defending an unfair dismissal claim no better than 35-40% as framed; the s.103A and Equality Act heads are uncapped. Pleaded schedule lands around £184k, realistic award £140-190k. I've recommended opening at £180k with a target of £230-250k and a ceiling of £265k.

Grateful for your steer before it goes to Richard and Karen.

Tom

Tom Gallagher
Associate | Employment
Whitfield Carter LLP
T: 020 7946 0021

messages.plaintextBody:
Good note. Two things: (1) make crystal clear the grievance must be heard on its merits before any dismissal decision, or we hand them the ACAS uplift; (2) I'd hold the ceiling at £265k but be ready to go to the Board if Bartlett pushes past it. Send it across once amended.

Sarah
